title: Tanzania in July and August: Busy but Beautiful
excerpt: July and August are high season in Tanzania: dry weather, river crossings and busy parks. How to make the most of it.
body:
## Why it is popular

- Dry weather and clear skies.
- The migration in the north, with [river crossings](/blog/great-migration-river-crossings/).
- European summer holidays.

## Downsides

- Busier parks and higher prices.
- Book early.

## Tips

- Spend nights in quieter regions, like the far north or Tarangire's concessions.
- Start game drives early.
- Consider the [southern circuit](/blog/southern-circuit-tanzania/), which is quiet even in high season.

## Weather

Sunny days, cold mornings and evenings, especially in Ngorongoro. Bring warm layers.

## Kilimanjaro and Zanzibar

Both are at their best.

Read our page about [July and August](/a-safari-in-tanzania-in-july-and-august/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
